content.text:
The suite is green: 2 of 2 tests pass.

The test wasn't flaky. It was catching a real bug. `invoiceDate` in `invoice.js` used local-time getters (`getFullYear`, `getMonth`, `getDate`). Its own comment says invoices are dated in UTC. On a server in Tokyo (UTC+9), any invoice created after 15:00 UTC was dated a day late. For example, `2026-03-05T23:30Z` came out as `2026-03-06`.

I switched to the UTC getters (`getUTCFullYear`, `getUTCMonth`, `getUTCDate`). I didn't skip or loosen the test. Production invoices in non-UTC regions would have been misdated, so this fix matters beyond CI.
